description: This file contains server-side request handling logic for a Remix application using React and Node. It manages HTTP requests, sets CORS headers, handles bot detection, and streams server-rendered React components.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main exported function handling incoming HTTP requests, determining if the request is from a bot or browser, and routing to appropriate handler.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot requests using streaming responsive content.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser requests using streaming responsive content.
